notes: Verified across breakpoints, not from the class name alone. At 1440 it renders as a static 2-card grid and the DOM carries NO carousel controls (no arrows, dots, slick/glide/splide, aria-roledescription). At 375 the first card fills the viewport with the second peeking in at the right edge, i.e. the track overflows horizontally. So: carousel behaviour at mobile, plain grid at desktop. Open for mapping: whether EDS needs a real carousel block or a scroll-snap row is enough, given there are only 2 slides and no controls.
